race.comment: LUCKY PAT (1)is a promising gelding resuming for the Webster camp, bringing juvenile black-type form with strong showings behind the talented The Next Episode. His two trials have been sharp and he can make a bright return. PIERANTES (12) made quite the impression on debut with a barnstorming win at the Sunny Cost. Suspect she's above average and from the good draw she can play a major role. FINAL CRUSADE (5) justified favouritism here first-up and keeps Thompson, but will need to raise the bar again. OLIVONI (6) ripped along in front but was collared late at the short quote. Is sure to have come on from that and will likely take it up to them again. Could prove tough to reel in. VINCLEY (7) dominated fresh and fell just short from making it two on the bounce at the Sunny Coast. Peaking now and has enough dash to offset the wide alley.
